Symbolic dynamic compilation costs 0.757 s for the first shape and less than 0.2 ms for each subsequent first call, reducing cumulative shape-transition cost by approximately 70%.
To isolate shape handling, we run the elementwise graph at four previously unseen leading dimensions (2,304, 3,584, 5,632, and 7,168), holding the second dimension at 1,024.
CLM-ARCH-0187.statement: For the elementwise chain workload, dynamic-shape compilation reduces cumulative shape-transition cost by approximately 70%.

extra_quotes: Experiments run on one NVIDIA RTX A6000 GPU using Python 3.10.15, PyTorch 2.3.1, CUDA 12.1, cuDNN 8.9.2, and Triton 2.3.1. For each execution mode, we perform 10 warm-up iterations followed by 50 measured iterations. GPU latency is measured using synchronized CUDA events and reported as the median; the interquartile ranges were narrow (at most 2.9% of the median).
Results should not be interpreted as a leaderboard among TVM, XLA, TensorRT, or other systems, nor generalized to end-to-end models, training, other hardware, or other software versions.
